a.xlink:title: Prints all packets currently stored in a Manager.
Prints bytes in hexadecimal form to standard output.
Prints a human-readable summary of one packet to standard output.
Prints the primary header owned by a packet.
Prints the secondary-header and application-data portions of a packet.
Prints a DataField summary.
Returns spacing used by the diagnostic bit-field formatter.
Atomically parses exactly six serialized primary-header bytes.
Prints a primary-header summary.
Decodes the first six bytes from a caller-owned buffer.
Loads a CCSDS-standard big-endian 16-bit value.
Loads a 16-bit integer using explicit wire byte order.
Loads 0..8 octets into a uint64_t using explicit wire byte order.
Returns the stored 11-bit Application Process Identifier.
Formats the low-order bits of an integer as a binary string.
Returns the encoded Packet Data Length value N-1.
Packs the six-byte header into the low 48 bits of a 64-bit integer.
Returns the stored 1-bit secondary-header presence flag.
Returns the stored 14-bit sequence count.
Returns the stored 2-bit sequence-flags value.
Returns the stored 1-bit packet type.
Returns the stored 3-bit protocol version.
